profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Rivian (Ex Netflix, Lyft)
profile.summary:
9+ years of experience in building highly scalable cloud based services with 100 million+ users , by leveraging technologies like Java, Python and AWS

Strong analytical and problem solving approach. Having good understanding of object oriented concepts and proficient with computer fundamentals and data structures. 

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with an ability to work in an SDLC and Agile environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Gatos, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Part of team responsible for building personalized content catalogs including live events for over 300 million users

• Introduced and implemented Unified content ID, establishing a standardized approach for data consistency across engineering and ML teams (Java, SpringBoot)

• Re-architected and built a scalable service,enabling targeted insertions and suppressions of movies, shows, games, to support promotional event strategies (Java, EC2, S3, MSK)

• Developed content selection APIs (batching and non-batching) and led migration efforts across multiple teams, delivering ~$1.5M in cost savings (Java, SpringBoot)

• Created a comprehensive runbook to streamline onboarding and support adoption across teams

• Conducted thorough parity and performance testing to ensure readiness for production deployment (Python)

• Led project tracking via a centralized tracker and facilitated biweekly progress meetings.

• Initiated and led a recurring “QA Week” to address technical debt and improve overall code quality

• Mentored and provided guidance to new engineers across the organization
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Microservices · GraphQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: • Develop features related to Turo Risk service (Python, Java)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Participated in all aspects of software development activities, including design, coding, code review, bug fixing, and documentation

• Designed and implemented multiple new services to compute and pay drivers for non-route based pay use cases from spec to delivering successful high quality development, deployment and maintenance (Golang, ProtoBuf)

• Delivered critical features to drive reduction in driver cancellation rate by collaborating with the data science team (Python)

• Worked cross functionally in launching pricing experiments in 37 regions which increased the drivers hours by 4%

• Built fast prototype of ideas to demonstrate improvement in Driver Engagement spend

• Responsible for setting up alarms, dashboards , analytics events and documenting steps in runbook to debug issues. Member of Observability group at Lyft (Kibana, Wavefront)

• Help define the team roadmap planning to onboard products and documented technical gaps; Set up project gantt chart for milestone tracking

• Owned the troubleshooting, resolution and postmortem for multiple Sevs

• Organized brown bag sessions to share knowledge across teams.

• Mentored and provided guidance to engineers and interns across the organization

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed Synchronous AWS Lambda function with REST API trigger to review patient visits, which resulted in 15% increase in reviewing more visits (Golang, API Gateway, Elasticache, SAM, RDS, Secrets Manager)

• Designed and Developed an async telephone feature to enable/disable Secure Live Video (SLV) calls along with flashing signal service (Nodejs, PHP)

• Built order status functionality using Asynchronous AWS Lambda function with SQS input trigger (Golang, SQS, SAM)

• Implemented outgoing SMS functionality with the ability to respond to incoming messages using Twilio

• Responsible for development and designing of the patient and clinical team facing application (AngularJs, html, CSS)

•   Responsible for booking an appointment, Check in and out of an equipment, process payments through the computer system.

company.name: Student Recreation Center at California State University Fullerton

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for development of cross-platform mobile application for online searching and booking of flights using JavaScript framework Ionic and AngularJs over the Spring MVC Framework thus providing much richer set of options for the front end of the application

Created services and factories in AngularJs to search the airports based on user’s location which optimized the component based architecture

Developed custom filters like GroupAirports and DisplayAirports to display data according to required format and used reusable components available in Ionic Framework, thus promoting reusability of commonly used built in or custom filter functions and enhancing the User Interface

Fixed bugs from existing websites and implemented enhancements that significantly improved web functionality and speed

Part of the Project Code Review Committee and an active contributor to the Technical code development

Collaborated with the other team members to plan, design and develop the robust solution. Coordinated with the testing team to achieve quality and performance of the software

Analyzed and interpreted the technical requirements and actively participated in the daily scrum meetings

certifications.title: Oracle Certified Professional, Java SE 6 Programmer

projects.title: Travel Site (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, NodeJS, Gulp, PostCSS)
projects.description:
•Designed the CSS stylesheet using the BEM methodology for writing the selectors
•Implemented autoprefixer, nestedCSS, CSS variables, importing files in the CSS stylesheet using PostCSS 
•Implemented Webpack for bundling JavaScript and other third party library files and babel was implemented to use EcmaScript 6 features 
•Incorporated waypoints to provide different scrolling events and mixins to make the website responsive 
•Improved the speed of the website by using imagemin for compressing the size of the images, and implemented Lazy-loading (lazysizes) 
•Developed a single svg and png file consisting of all the website icons to serve the webpage using gulp-svg-sprite package

projects.title: San Francisco Crime Classification (Python, R-Programming)
projects.description:
•	A Kaggle competition to classify the crime based on various attributes like Day of week, PDdistrict, date, etc. 
•	Implemented using python using various algorithms such as Naïve Bayes, K-NN, Random Forest and Logistic Regression and I was able to achieve 875 Rank.
•	Preprocessed data using library called Pandas available in Python to predict the result.
•	Analyzed and Interpreted the data using RapidMiner tool, thus getting information of which area had the higher crime rate.
•	Implemented in R programming using Naïve Bayes algorithms to compare with the results obtained using Python.
